stem: Tanya reads a school health leaflet about adolescent changes, including menstruation and other signs of puberty.

statements.text: Many adolescent changes, including menstruation and other puberty signs, are mainly caused and regulated by hormones produced in the body.
Menstruation produces the hormones that start puberty.
Every change during adolescence, including choosing new friends, is mainly caused by hormones.

teacher.key_rationale: Hormones mainly cause and regulate puberty changes including menstruation. Menstruation does not produce those hormones, and not every social choice in adolescence is mainly hormonal.
